title: 20% off Select Liquor Products Online, 2 Uses Per Account @ Liquorland Coles
body:
Deal: 20% off Select Liquor Products Online, 2 Uses Per Account @ Liquorland Coles

[itshammer] can someone let me in on the process ?
is this the discount for first online order?
[deekay91] No, it doesn't need to be the first online order. Its straight forward, add to cart and can do click and collect by selecting a slot or can be delivered for a fee.
[VladImpaler] First time I've ever got click'n'collect to work for booze on the Coles site.
[Stewardo] It only works if there is an adjacent liquorland
[King Steuart] Thanks, grabbed a Glenfiddich for $64. Is there any way to get a list like we do with BWS for discounts and stock location?
[DealHunted] $15 off on $50 purchase is a separate offer that's going on. Unfortunately, doesn't stack.
https://www.coles.com.au/promotions/halloween-spend-save/liq…
[P3TR0] Nice!
Bought a slab of VB cans for $45.60
[Jstrrrr] Does anyone know if the spend on Liquorland via Coles Online at Coles.com.au would count towards the "spend $xxx per week for 4 weeks for xxxx Flybuys points" deals? No other "regular Coles" items in the order.
[honkyb] I don't think grog counts as it is Liquorland not coles
[AnDyStYLe] Yes it does, I’ve been doing for a while now.
Although keep in mind if you are spending like $100-$200 often, your future spend $xxx will get bumped up dramatically, like mine did.
Took a few skipped offers for it to come back down again!
